confirmed: The endpoint returns same-day minute bars only.
One request returns at most 30 rows.
A future input time can repeat the current price rather than produce future bars.
The first cntg_vol row can temporarily contain the prior minute volume before the first trade of a new minute.
FID_ETC_CLS_CODE supports a close/after-hours exclusion mode.
The endpoint supports continuation and configurable time units.
The endpoint provides only the latest 30 minutes during 09:00-15:30 and cannot continue to older rows.
After the close, timestamps from 15:30 through 17:00 can be returned while every row contains the same closing data.
One request can return up to 102 rows in production.
The request explicitly accepts date and time inputs.
FID_HOUR_CLS_CODE=60 denotes one-minute bars and FID_FAKE_TICK_INCU_YN=N excludes fake ticks.
